statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Current evidence is mixed and does not verify a persistent one-way NQ path; the U.S. cash close remains the principal near-term checkpoint.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: WATCH through the U.S. cash-close window; a sustained closing extension with weak or failed retracements would be the condition for a higher Tail band.
headline: Mixed post-payroll structure keeps Tail at WATCH into the cash close
body: August payrolls increased by 162,000 and unemployment held at 4.1%, pushing Treasury yields higher. Reuters' latest equity update showed major indexes lower, but Nasdaq breadth was nearly balanced and semiconductors outperformed. A sufficiently fresh direct NQ quote was not verified, limiting confidence in any claim of persistent one-way structure.

lookbackSummary: Tail was elevated into Thursday evening, normalized overnight, held mostly WATCH before payrolls, briefly fell low after two-sided post-release trading, rose to 28% on a delayed downside leg at 16:00 UTC, and returned to WATCH as the path retraced.
outlookSummary: Tail is expected to ease below WATCH after the cash close if late-session extension does not reappear. Weekend market closure reduces live path evidence, while elevated rates and Middle East energy risk keep Stress high to extreme and preserve reopening-gap sensitivity.

forecast.analysis: Current evidence is mixed: Reuters shows major indexes lower after payrolls, but Nasdaq breadth is nearly balanced and semiconductors outperform. A sufficiently fresh direct NQ quote was not verified, so persistent one-way structure is not asserted.
